Halfling cleric of the Harvest Mother

Brother Wendell Tumbleberry runs a small temple infirmary in the Lower City and writes the Gazette's health and nature column between soup batches. He believes most problems can be solved by rest, fresh air, and a hearty bowl of something, and he is right more often than the Clerics' Disease Council would like.

Covers: Health, Environment, Science, Creature Features
Feuding with: Nyx Spindlecoil
